subject: Pilot wrap: Ops KPI snapshot + quick testimonial ask
messages:
From: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.ai>
To: Samantha Ortiz <samantha.ortiz@clearcommerce.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 14 Feb 2028 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Pilot wrap: Ops KPI snapshot + quick testimonial ask

Hi Samantha —

Thanks again for partnering with us on the two-week POC. Quick recap of what we saw running Redwood against your production-like traces: 

- Latency: 45% reduction in average response time; P95 moved from ~210ms to ~115ms for the common 512-token working set.
- Throughput: sustained 3x higher requests/sec on the Dedicated profile with consistent tail latencies.
- Cost: token-based unit cost dropped ~38% after enabling prefix caching + optimized batching.
- Error rate: transient error spikes eliminated after KV cache tweak; successful request rate now >99.8%.

I attached a short metric one-pager and the mutual action plan we followed (attached). Can I ask two quick favors: 
1) Would ClearCommerce be open to a 1–2 line quote we can use in a short case blurb (we'll share the copy before publishing)?
2) Could you spare 15 minutes next week for a short on-camera or phone chat so marketing can capture a 30–45s soundbite?

Proposed 15-min slots (PST): Wed 2/22 10:00–10:15, Thu 2/23 13:00–13:15, or Fri 2/24 09:00–09:15. If none work, send a couple alternatives and we’ll adapt.

Appreciate your partnership — this was a great, fast test.

Thanks,
Soojin Lee
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
soojin.lee@redwood.ai | (415) 555-0198

Attachments:
- clearcommerce-poc-metrics-1p.pdf (metrics one-pager, 1 page)
- mutual-action-plan.xlsx (M.A.P. used during pilot)

You're welcome to attribute to: Samantha Ortiz, VP of Engineering, ClearCommerce.

I'm also happy to jump on a 15-minute call — Wed 2/22 at 10:00 PST works for me. If you need a recording or a brief on-camera clip, we can do that in the same window.
